test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners, while some are sitting at the middle of the sides. B sits third to the left of H. B sits at one of the corners. G does not sit at any of the corners. C sits second to the right of G. G is not an immediate neighbour of B. Only three people sit between D and E. D is an immediate neighbour of F. D does not sit at any of the middle of the sides.

Who sits second to the left of A?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. 

Some of them are sitting at the corners, while some are sitting at the middle of the sides. 

1) B sits third to the left of H. 

2) B sits at one of the corners. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10723676a51f823c57e46bf73e7006fad7ce2d86f28affcd4b9e61a8ac9582ad.png] 

3) G does not sit at any of the corners and G is not an immediate neighbour of B.

4) C sits second to the right of G. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f419279851bc102fca98f98491fbb32cdda4c673b811e42bf2f2f1aabd4bbbd.png] 

5) Only three people sit between D and E. 

6) D is an immediate neighbour of F. 

7) D does not sit at any of the middle of the sides.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3016e7322cb30d746b10078d012839815d05c9d65f50f883b95bb982bb00e613.png] 

And, 'A' will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd42208916b276ed9ea22f2b924a36f9e49613c2ce641efb5c5f305bb6cd0070.png] 

So, 'D' sits second to the left of A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
